notes.title: UPDATE: More horror
notes.content:
This patch, we decided to make the game a bit more frightening:

[list]
[*] Added screamers in the Psychiatric Hospital
[*] Reduced the brightness of many light sources
[*] Added an atmospheric 3D scene to the main menu
[*] Fixed several bugs. Including a number of mistakes in Chinese game version.
[/list]
Also, our team keeps working on the third map - it will be an abandoned subway. Now we are at the stage of quests programming

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770313/5079674c73de74d093818f821f958183b0c63494.jpg[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE + Secret of May
notes.content:
Today we've decided to release the game in full access. The game has two levels with two different endings in each

[h3]List of recent improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Secret of May room
[*] Some new animations of enemies
[*] Search bar in the friendlist
[*] Some improvements of UI
[*] Bug fix
[/list]

[h2]Third level[/h2]

We are currently working on the third level. It will be an abandoned subway. We plan to release this level in late July - early August

[h3]Some screenshots of the third level[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770313/814007152892cb9418e534185fb5e5f4d54fec17.jpg[/img]

notes.title: April Update
notes.content:
Over the past 2 weeks we have made several small updates

[h2]Full changelog[/h2]

[list]
[*] April's secret room
[*] Thrown objects in the Psychiatric Hospital
[*] Angry nurses and cultists can sometimes attack each other
[*] Removing network delays when opening doors
[*] New screamers in the Psychiatric Hospital
[*] Nurse Animation Improvements
[*] New skin - Nurse
[/list]

[h2]What's next[/h2]

We are working on improving the enemy AI and the third level


[h2]Some screenshots of this update[/h2]

notes.title: Fixing server issues
notes.content:
We changed servers to more stable ones. And added 2 regions to the game: EU, USA. Now the bugs with doors and opponents should disappear. Connection problems in some countries should also disappear

Should we add the ASIA region?

[h2]Enemy AI[/h2]

We are working on making enemies 'smarter'. If you have ideas how best to do this - please write to us!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770313/3e6d19643281fbe705affe4040328c22f481aec6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update February 2022
notes.content:
[h1]Today we released a big game update:[/h1]

1. [b]Added difficulty levels.[/b] Be careful, on "insane" difficulty, the cultists will kill you in the cupboard if the flashlight is on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770313/347ab16279a59f584431223096fd64e6403eb15c.jpg[/img]

2. [b]Items that can be thrown.[/b] It is now possible to throw some items to distract or damage the cultists and spiderlady

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770313/2372586d2ca589b42e8b8372f6f686e78a3336c0.jpg[/img]

3. [b]Secret of month.[/b] Starting this month, we will be adding new hidden chests and rooms that will offer higher rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770313/831afbdaf0d3b7613963c160c9cda34b69e9b877.jpg[/img]

4. [b]New skin.[/b] Want to be like a cultist?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770313/755f401422ae2b0cea5f2b47f5054157b79189a3.jpg[/img]

5. [b]Rank systems.[/b] The more wins, the higher the rank

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770313/37ce7bbb6d0bf7bf77164914b1b00b70386f947e.jpg[/img]


[h2]Also we continue to make a new level - abandoned psychiatric hospital:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40770313/2ee033049d63c95af5db805db983a4f0576d2584.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Patch 15 October
notes.content:
Patch 15 October:
[list]
[*] A clear description of the goal of the game
[*] Increasing the resolution of textures
[*] Reducing the number of cultists on the map
[*] Highlighting important doors
[*] Adding the sound of a friend heal
[*] Acceleration of crawling
[*] other minor edits
[/list]

High quality graphics now require a 3 GB VRAM
